cohort: The study included 150 women with a live singleton fetus in the cephalic position who underwent induced labor at term.
finding: Maternal age ≥35 years, BMI ≥30 kg/m2, nulliparity, preinduction Bishop's score less than 5, gestational diabetes mellitus, and intrauterine growth restriction were significantly associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery in induced labors at term.
mod_finding: Maternal age ≥35 years, BMI ≥30 kg/m2, nulliparity, preinduction Bishop's score less than 5, gestational diabetes mellitus, and intrauterine growth restriction were significantly associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery in induced labors at term.
cross-section timing: Data was collected over a period of one year.
